question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following union territories has the lowest population?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Daman and Diu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daman and Diu** was reported as the **union territory with the lowest population** according to the **Census of India 2011**.
 
• The population of **Daman and Diu** was recorded at approximately **2,42,911**, making it the least populated union territory in India.
 
• The union territory is divided into two separate districts: **Daman** and **Diu**, located on the western coast of India.
 
• **Daman** is situated near Gujarat, while **Diu** is an island close to the southern coast of Gujarat.
 
• Daman and Diu were former Portuguese colonies and became part of India in **1961**.
 
• The region is known for its **beaches, historical forts, and churches**, attracting tourists from across the country.
 
• In 2020, **Daman and Diu** were merged with **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** to form a single union territory known as **Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Puducherry**__

 __
 
• **Puducherry** is a union territory located in southern India and consists of four districts: **Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam**.
 
• It was a **French colony** before being incorporated into India in **1954**.
 
• Puducherry is known for its **French architecture, cultural heritage, and spiritual centers**, such as the **Auroville** and **Sri Aurobindo Ashram**.
 
 
 
• **Chandigarh**__
 __
 
• **Chandigarh** is a union territory and the capital of both **Punjab** and **Haryana**.
 
• It is known for its **modern urban design**, planned by the famous Swiss-French architect **Le Corbusier**.
 
• The city is known for its **green spaces** like the **Rock Garden** and **Sukhna Lake**.
 
 
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__
 
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** is a union territory located in western India, bordering Gujarat and Maharashtra.
 
• The region was under **Portuguese rule** until it joined India in **1961**.
 
• It is known for its **lush greenery, tribal heritage, and natural beauty**.
